slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙

;;
“寒风，今夜就算补偿了你多年的照顾，仙凡有别，我们……就此别过吧。”
虽已过八十余载，未婚妻冰冷的声音还犹如昨天般在北寒风脑中回荡着。
“是啊！……仙凡有别。”
北寒风靠在村口老槐树下，浑浊的双眼看着远处嬉闹的孩童，手无意识地摩挲着一个系黄绳的红皮葫芦，这是和他一起穿越过来的酒葫芦。
“过了今日，我明儿就百岁了……活的真够久啊！”
八十多年前，他被测出无修仙灵根，而未婚妻林雪瑶则被测出中品灵根，和他一夜之欢后，踏入仙门，从此仙凡有别。
虽也曾挣扎，不甘过，但最终还是回了穿越到的第一站——葫芦村，和普通人一样，娶妻，生子。
妻子，儿媳先后离世后，唯一的孙子，说是要寻个前程，去城里闯荡后，家里目前就他一人了。
“也不知道那小子去城里闯荡的怎么样了？”北寒风拨开红葫芦木塞，往嘴里倒入一小口桂花酒，望着城里的方向喃喃道。
就在这时，天际传来两道破空之声！
嗖——嗖——
村民们惊愕抬头，只见一青一白两道流光，从空中落在村口打谷场。
光芒敛去，现出一男一女两道身影。他们并未落地，而是脚踩剑，离地三尺，虚空而立。
男子青年模样，面容冷峻，背负长剑。女子气质清冷，衣袂飘飘，宛如画中仙。
两人强大的气息毫不掩饰地扩散开，压得所有村民几乎喘不过气。
“仙……仙人！”有点见识的老人颤着声喊道。
北寒风扶着老槐树缓缓地站起身，浑浊的眼睛看向半空中的两仙人。
御剑而行，仙家手段！
村民们从震惊中回过神后，接续着对半空中两人匍匐跪拜。

背负长剑男修扫过下方匍匐的村民，眼神宛如看蝼蚁，声音带着一丝不耐：“此村所有六岁以上，十六岁以下者，全部上前。”
一旁的白衣女修没有说话，只是目光淡然地扫视着下方众人，落在槐树下那个唯一站着的身影时，眉微不可察地蹙了一下。
这老人体内死气沉沉，气血枯败，分明是寿元将尽之兆。
很快，村里十几二十个适龄孩子被各自家人带到打谷场，脸上混杂着恐惧与期待。
待所有孩子自觉排好队。
背负长剑男修手一翻，掌心出现一颗拳头大小、晶莹剔透的圆珠。“此乃测灵珠，尔等依次将手放于其上，凝神静气。”
一男孩按排好队的顺序，第一个依言把手放在冰凉的测灵珠上，测灵珠毫无反应。
“无灵根，下一个。”男修声音冷淡。
顺着队伍，第二个女孩手放上去，测灵珠依旧黯淡。
“无灵根，下一个。”
第三个，第四个……直至最后一个孩子失望地放下手，测灵珠始终如死物一般，黯淡无光。
“全是凡胎朽木！”男修冷哼一声，收起测灵珠，显然不打算再浪费时间，“师妹，看来这村子灵气稀薄瘠，难出仙苗，我们走吧。”
白衣女修微微颔首，正欲转身。
异变陡生！
白衣女修腰间悬着的一龙形玉佩，毫无征兆地嗡鸣震颤起来，随后猛地脱离了她的衣带，化作一道白光，倏地飞向倚着老槐树的北寒风！
在所有人惊愕的注视下，那龙形玉佩悬停在北寒风胸前，白光如水流淌，照耀着他苍老的身躯。
“怎么回事？”背负长剑的男修猛地转身，眼中精光一闪。
白衣女修清冷的脸上第一次露出惊容：“我的探玄玉……自行测试？这……”
北寒风只觉得胸口一暖，龙形玉佩发出的白光似乎带着某种气在他枯萎的身躯流动着。

"Hanfeng, tonight is just compensation for your years of care. There is a difference between immortals and mortals. Let's just say goodbye."
Although more than eighty years have passed, his fiancée's cold voice still echoes in Bei Hanfeng's mind just like yesterday.
"Yes!...There is a difference between immortals and mortals."
Beihanfeng leaned under the old locust tree at the entrance of the village, looking at the children playing in the distance with his cloudy eyes. His hand unconsciously rubbed a red leather gourd with a yellow string. This was the wine gourd that he had traveled through time with.
"After today, I will be a hundred years old tomorrow... I have lived a long enough time!"
More than eighty years ago, he was found to have no immortal spiritual roots, while his fiancée Lin Xueyao was found to have medium-grade spiritual roots. After a night of fun with him, she stepped into the immortal gate and was different from the immortals ever since.
Although he struggled and was unwilling to give up, he finally returned to the first stop he traveled to - Hulu Village. Like ordinary people, he married a wife and had children.
After his wife and daughter-in-law passed away, the only grandson said he wanted to find a future and went to the city to make a living. Now he is the only one in the family.
"I wonder what happened to that kid who went to the city?" Bei Hanfeng opened the cork of the red gourd, poured a small sip of osmanthus wine into his mouth, and murmured while looking in the direction of the city.
At this moment, two piercing sounds came from the sky!
Whoosh——whoosh——
The villagers looked up in shock and saw two streams of light, one green and one white, falling from the sky on the threshing floor at the entrance of the village.
The light faded away, revealing two figures, a man and a woman. They did not land on the ground, but stood with their swords on their feet, three feet above the ground, in the void.
The man looks like a young man, with a stern face and a long sword on his back. The woman has a cool temperament and fluttering clothes, just like a fairy in a painting.
The powerful aura of the two spread out unabashedly, making all the villagers almost breathless.
"Immortal...immortal!" the knowledgeable old man shouted tremblingly.
Bei Hanfeng stood up slowly while holding the old locust tree, and looked at the two immortals in mid-air with his cloudy eyes.
Walking with a sword, the methods of the immortal family!
After the villagers recovered from the shock, they knelt down and worshiped the two men in mid-air.
The male cultivator carrying a long sword glanced at the prostrate villagers below, his eyes were like looking at ants, and his voice was impatient: "Everyone in this village who is over six years old and under sixteen years old, please come forward."
The female cultivator in white clothes on the side did not speak, but glanced at the people below indifferently. When she fell on the only figure standing under the locust tree, she frowned slightly.
The old man's body was filled with lifeless energy and his energy and blood were withered, which was clearly a sign that his life span was about to end.
Soon, a dozen or twenty school-age children in the village were taken to the threshing floor by their respective families, with a mixture of fear and expectation on their faces.
Wait for all the children to line up consciously.
The male cultivator carrying the long sword turned his hand over, and a crystal clear ball the size of a fist appeared in his palm. "This is the spirit-measuring bead. You all place your hands on it one by one and concentrate on it."
A boy lined up in order and was the first to put his hand on the cold spirit-measuring bead, but there was no reaction from the spirit-measuring bead.
"No spiritual root, next." The male cultivator's voice was cold.
Following the line, the second girl put her hand on it, but the spirit-testing orb was still dim.
"No spiritual roots, next one."
The third, the fourth... until the last child put down his hand in disappointment, the spirit-measuring orb was always like a dead thing, dim and dull.
"It's all rotten wood!" The male cultivator snorted coldly and put away the spirit-testing beads, obviously not intending to waste any more time. "Junior sister, it seems that the spiritual energy in this village is thin and barren, and it is difficult for immortal seedlings to emerge. Let's go."
The female cultivator in white nodded slightly and was about to turn around.
A sudden change occurred!
The dragon-shaped jade pendant hanging from the waist of the female cultivator in white buzzed and trembled without warning, then suddenly broke away from her belt, turned into a ray of white light, and flew towards the cold north wind leaning against the old locust tree!
Under everyone's stunned gaze, the dragon-shaped jade pendant hovered on Bei Hanfeng's chest, and white light flowed like water, illuminating his old body.
"What's going on?" The male cultivator with the sword on his back turned around suddenly, his eyes flashing.The cold face of the female cultivator in white showed a look of shock for the first time: "My Mysterious Jade...Test it on your own? This..."
Bei Hanfeng only felt a warmth in his chest, and the white light emitted by the dragon-shaped jade pendant seemed to be flowing with some kind of energy in his withered body.
